basic_info.description: Delight in urban living in this full service 1BR + Den home at The Infinity. The home is finished with glue down Ash hardwood floors, Studio Becker cabinetry, upgraded California Closet System, Bosch & Thermador appliances, and more. Unit does not have a parking space.    International Superstar Architect Bernardo Fort-Brescia of Arquitectonica and local powerhouse Heller Manus have created the quintessential living experience along San Francisco's waterfront complete with a full suite of luxury amenities. Amenities include 24 hr doorman & concierge, club room, 5000SF gym, 75-foot lap pool, theater room, business center and more.
